title: First Steps
description: The first month is all about survival and building a foundation.
checklist: Clear 20 tiles of your farm
Plant parsnips (15-20 seeds)
Craft a chest for storage
Upgrade backpack at Pierre's (2,000g)
Meet all 28 villagers at least once
Complete the Spring Crops Bundle
Reach Fishing Level 3
Reach Farming Level 2 (build Scarecrow)
Catch a Catfish in the rain
Save at least 5,000g for Summer seeds

title: First Week Checklist
description: A day-by-day guide for your first week in Stardew Valley.
checklist: Day 1: Clear 15 tiles, plant 15 parsnips, water them, talk to everyone you see
Day 2: Water crops, explore town, visit the Beach, meet Willy
Day 3: Water crops, enter the Museum, start fishing at the mountain lake
Day 4: Harvest parsnips! Plant second batch. Forage in Cindersap Forest
Day 5: Reach Fishing Level 2. Buy Fiberglass Rod from Willy
Day 6: Mine exploration - gather copper ore in the Mines (levels 1-10)
Day 7: Save energy. Craft Scarecrow if Farming Level 2. Check Traveling Cart

title: Summer & Fall Foundations
description: Expand your farm, build animals, and prepare for the Skull Cavern.
checklist: Plant blueberries on Summer 1 (high profit, regrowth)
Build a Silo before getting animals
Build a Coop and get 4-6 chickens
Build a Barn and get 2-4 cows
Unlock the Bus (complete Vault bundles)
Reach the Bottom of the Mines (Level 120)
Obtain the Skull Key (from Level 120 chest)
Craft Quality Sprinklers (Farming Level 6)
Build a Barn for sheep/goats
Plant cranberries in Fall (best fall profit)
Build a Tapper operation on oak trees
Purchase the Greenhouse (Pantry bundles)
Save 25,000g for the bus repair

title: Winter & Year 1 Completion
description: Maximize Winter profits and complete Year 1 strong.
checklist: Upgrade axe to Gold or Iridium in Winter
Upgrade pickaxe to Gold or Iridium in Winter
Fill Greenhouse with Ancient Fruit or Starfruit
Build Deluxe Barn for pigs (truffle money)
Unlock and explore Skull Cavern
Reach Level 100 of Skull Cavern
Craft Lightning Rods (prepare for Summer storms)
Build Farm Computer to track production
Build a Slime Hutch (optional)
Reach Level 10 in at least 3 skills
Save 50,000g+ for Spring Year 2

title: Year 2+ Perfection
description: Work toward 100% completion and the true endgame.
checklist: Complete all Community Center bundles
Obtain all 50 Monster Slayer rewards
Donate all 95+ items to the Museum
Cook all 80+ recipes
Craft every recipe
Catch every fish (including Legendary)
Reach 10 hearts with every villager
Ship every item (Full Shipment achievement)
Complete the Missing Bundle (Movie Theater)
Reach 100% Perfection on the farm tracker
Obtain all Stardrops and max energy
Build the Golden Clock (10,000,000g)
Obtain the Statue of True Perfection
